Entries.Text: Display Rotation
Display Rotation
Rotate the model in the viewport to view it from other angles. This only changes how the model is shown: the model data is not changed, and the rotation is never saved.
A model must be loaded first for this tool to work.
Rotation
The rotation of the displayed model, in degrees, about the model's origin.
The rotation about the X, Y and Z axes, in degrees. Drag to change a value, or double-click to type one. It stays set when another model is loaded.
Quick Rotate
Turn the model by a quarter turn about an axis.
Rotate 90° about X
Tip the model forward by a quarter turn.
Rotate 90° about Y
Turn the model by a quarter turn about the vertical axis.
Rotate 90° about Z
Roll the model sideways by a quarter turn.
Turntable
Spin the model continuously about the vertical axis.
Spin
Spin the model about the vertical axis. It keeps spinning while another tool is shown.
The spin speed, in degrees per second. A negative speed spins the other way.
Actions
Actions for the display rotation.
Reset
Return the model to its original orientation and stop the turntable.
